description: Set a Shield app's enforcement mode: observe (learn, block nothing), alert, or enforce (block deviations). Enforce requires an approved baseline unless force=true. Requires NEMESIS_API_KEY.

appId.description: The app id (from nemesis_list_apps or nemesis_create_app)

force.description: Override the enforce-readiness gate (leaves an audit trail)

name: nemesis_set_mode
